gate.name: HW
gate.description: max|S| <= 2 on every member with the DF controller; model members also Nyquist stable. Measured members: Hl for f >= 70 Hz (lines up to 2499 Hz, design model above), frictionless design model on a dense log grid 0.5..70 Hz; extra delay 0 and +1 sample. Model members: design model (both amplitudes' fits) and the ms030 model with jl x{0.8,1.2} and k x{0.8,1.2}, dense grid 0.5..3990 Hz, extra delay 0 and +1.
